plugin.description: Controls OBS Studio from the deck: streaming, recording, scenes, sources, filters and audio.
plugin.requirements: OBS Studio with the obs-websocket server enabled, and a connection set up in the plugin's settings. Every action shows on the key when OBS cannot be reached. Every action also takes an optional "connection_id" setting, which picks one of several configured OBS connections; left out, the action uses the first one.

ToggleStream.description: Starts the stream if it is off and stops it if it is running. The key shows whether OBS is streaming.

ToggleRecord.description: Starts and stops recording. The key shows whether OBS is recording.

RecPlayPause.description: Pauses a running recording and resumes it again. Pair it with ToggleRecord - it only works while a recording is running.

ToggleReplayBuffer.description: Turns the replay buffer on and off. Pair it with SaveReplayBuffer, which needs the buffer to be running.

SaveReplayBuffer.description: Saves the last seconds from the replay buffer to disk - the clip-that-moment key. Needs the replay buffer to be running.

ToggleVirtualCamera.description: Starts and stops the virtual camera, so OBS shows up as a webcam in other programs.

ToggleStudioMode.description: Turns studio mode on and off, which gives OBS its preview and program views.

TriggerTransition.description: Triggers the current transition, which in studio mode pushes the preview to the program output.

SwitchScene.description: Switches OBS to a scene. Put one on each key to have every scene one press away.

scene.description: Name of the scene, exactly as it is called in OBS.

scene_collection.description: Name of the scene collection, exactly as it is called in OBS.

ToggleInputMute.description: Mutes and unmutes one audio input in OBS. The key shows whether it is currently muted.

input.description: Name of the audio input in OBS.

SetInputMute.description: Mutes or unmutes one audio input, always in the same direction. Use two keys - or two states of one key - when muting and unmuting should be separate; use ToggleInputMute for a single toggle key.

input.description: Name of the audio input in OBS.

InputDial.description: Controls the volume of an OBS audio input from a dial and shows it as a bar on the dial's display, optionally with a live level meter.

input.description: Name of the audio input in OBS.

live_meter.description: Show the input's live level instead of just the set volume.

bar_color.description: Color of the volume bar as [r, g, b, a], each from 0 to 255.

ToggleSceneItemEnabled.description: Shows and hides one source inside a scene - the usual key for switching an overlay or a camera on and off. The key shows whether the source is visible.

scene.description: Name of the scene the source sits in.

item.description: Name of the source inside that scene.

SetSceneItemEnabled.description: Shows or hides one source inside a scene, always in the same direction. Use two keys when showing and hiding should be separate; use ToggleSceneItemEnabled for a single toggle key.

scene.description: Name of the scene the source sits in.

item.description: Name of the source inside that scene.

ToggleSceneFilter.description: Turns a filter on a scene or source on and off. The key shows whether the filter is active.

scene.description: Name of the scene or source the filter belongs to.

SetSceneFilter.description: Turns a filter on or off, always in the same direction. Use ToggleSceneFilter for a single toggle key.

scene.description: Name of the scene or source the filter belongs to.

set_mode.description: "ENABLED" switches the filter on, "DISABLED" switches it off.

OBSStats.description: Shows up to three OBS statistics on one key - CPU load, output FPS and stream state. It updates itself and needs no press.

stats_count.description: How many of the three label rows to fill. Note it is written as text, not as a number.

stat_2.description: What the second row shows. Only used with stats_count 2 or higher.

stat_3.description: What the third row shows. Only used with stats_count 3.
